name: Bonded, Greater (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Price +4,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

A suit of greater bonded armor (or a greater bonded shield) functions as bonded armor but can also be directed to teleport the armor on to a willing target within 60 feet.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, teleport
